objectives: Describe how Israel was settled in Goshen.
Explain Joseph's law of the fifth part and the lesson of saving.
Describe Jacob's charge concerning his burial.
takeaways: Pharaoh gave the best of the land: Goshen, the land of Rameses.
When the money failed, the Egyptians gave their cattle, bodies and land for bread, and the land became Pharaoh's.
Give the fifth part and keep four parts: lay up for the years of trouble.
Israel grew and multiplied exceedingly in Goshen; Jacob lived 147 years.
Jacob made Joseph swear to bury him with his fathers: put on the spirit of the forefathers.
